_fixture: TEA `trace`'s optional gate-signal artifact, shaped from step-05-gate-decision.md §3b (v1.21.4). Written only when the run is gate-eligible (`allow_gate: true` AND collection_status COLLECTED AND the decision is one of PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL/WAIVED). Carries the categorical gate and per-criterion MET/PARTIAL/NOT_MET flags — and NO per-requirement rows, which is why it can only supply `gateStatus` to the conversion, never the matrix itself. e2e-trace-summary.json carries the same `gate_status` alongside its aggregates and is accepted interchangeably here.
rationale: P0 coverage is complete at 100%, but P1 coverage (67%) falls below the 90% target and overall coverage (63%) is under the 80% minimum.
